#!/bin/bash
# W8.1 Wave B driver #4 — 96-way (2026-09-26 third acceleration).
#
# Measured at 48 jobs: gem5 RSS 105MB uniform (4.93GB total), python stack
# 1.67GB → 96 jobs ≈ 13.5GB vs 19G available (5.5G margin), CPU 96/126.
# D28-stall throughput = jobs/600s exactly.
#   Lane 1: e082, ONE campaign @ 48 jobs — 2020 runs = 7.0h
#   Lane 2: six e083 campaigns as 3 sequential PAIRS, each campaign @ 24
#           jobs (2 concurrent) — 3 x 2.375h = 7.1h
# Wave B ETA ≈ tonight ~18:30 (was 9/27 01:30 at 48-way; 9/29 21:45
# original sequential).
#
# Restarts are deterministic (same seeds → same results); the ~35 min of
# progress in the killed 24-way campaigns is redone exactly.
#
# DONE gate identical to B3: both lanes exit AND e082 results >= 2000
# rows AND each e083 >= 334 rows → "Wave B formal DONE" appended to the
# same driver_waveB.log the periodic cron greps. Incomplete → exit 2,
# no marker.
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
LOG=runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log
say() { echo "[driverB4] $*" >> "$LOG"; }

avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -lt 14 ]; then
  say "ABORT: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way). Not launching."
  exit 1
fi

(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

say "=== Wave B4 (96-way: e082@48 + e083 pairs 2x24) start: $(date -Is) pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER avail=${avail}G ==="

(
  python3 tools/campaign.py campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-e082.yaml --jobs 48
  say "LANE1 e082 rc=$? (rows=$(wc -l < runs/ooo_w81_gate_e082/c0000/results.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0))"
) &
LANE1=$!

(
  run_pair() {
    say "LANE2 pair START: $1 + $2 ($(date -Is))"
    python3 tools/campaign.py "campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-$1.yaml" --jobs 24 &
    P1=$!
    python3 tools/campaign.py "campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-$2.yaml" --jobs 24 &
    P2=$!
    wait $P1; r1=$?
    wait $P2; r2=$?
    say "LANE2 pair END: $1 rc=$r1, $2 rc=$r2 ($(date -Is))"
    [ $r1 -ne 0 ] && say "CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$r1: $1"
    [ $r2 -ne 0 ] && say "CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$r2: $2"
  }
  run_pair e083_crc32       e083_matmult-int
  run_pair e083_md5sum      e083_minver
  run_pair e083_nbody       e083_wikisort
  say "LANE2 all six done."
) &
LANE2=$!

wait $LANE1 $LANE2
say "both lanes exited: $(date -Is). Verifying results completeness..."

OK=1
rows82=$(wc -l < runs/ooo_w81_gate_e082/c0000/results.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$rows82" -lt 2000 ]; then
  say "INCOMPLETE: e082 rows=$rows82 < 2000"
  OK=0
fi
for prog in crc32 matmult-int md5sum minver nbody wikisort; do
  r=$(wc -l < "runs/ooo_w81_gate_e083_${prog}/c0000/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$r" -lt 334 ]; then
    say "INCOMPLETE: e083_${prog} rows=$r < 334"
    OK=0
  fi
done

kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
if [ "$OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  say "Wave B formal DONE: $(date -Is) (96-way; e082 rows=$rows82; e083x6 verified)"
else
  say "Wave B4 lanes exited but results INCOMPLETE — orchestrator attention needed; NO DONE marker."
  exit 2
fi

#!/bin/bash
# W8.1 Wave B driver #4 — 96-way (2026-09-26 third acceleration).
#
# Measured at 48 jobs: gem5 RSS 105MB uniform (4.93GB total), python stack
# 1.67GB → 96 jobs ≈ 13.5GB vs 19G available (5.5G margin), CPU 96/126.
# D28-stall throughput = jobs/600s exactly.
#   Lane 1: e082, ONE campaign @ 48 jobs — 2020 runs = 7.0h
#   Lane 2: six e083 campaigns as 3 sequential PAIRS, each campaign @ 24
#           jobs (2 concurrent) — 3 x 2.375h = 7.1h
# Wave B ETA ≈ tonight ~18:30 (was 9/27 01:30 at 48-way; 9/29 21:45
# original sequential).
#
# Restarts are deterministic (same seeds → same results); the ~35 min of
# progress in the killed 24-way campaigns is redone exactly.
#
# DONE gate identical to B3: both lanes exit AND e082 results >= 2000
# rows AND each e083 >= 334 rows → "Wave B formal DONE" appended to the
# same driver_waveB.log the periodic cron greps. Incomplete → exit 2,
# no marker.
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0
LOG=runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log
say() { echo "[driverB4] $*" >> "$LOG"; }

avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -lt 14 ]; then
  say "ABORT: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way). Not launching."
  exit 1
fi

(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

say "=== Wave B4 (96-way: e082@48 + e083 pairs 2x24) start: $(date -Is) pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER avail=${avail}G ==="

(
  python3 tools/campaign.py campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-e082.yaml --jobs 48
  say "LANE1 e082 rc=$? (rows=$(wc -l < runs/ooo_w81_gate_e082/c0000/results.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0))"
) &
LANE1=$!

(
  run_pair() {
    say "LANE2 pair START: $1 + $2 ($(date -Is))"
    python3 tools/campaign.py "campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-$1.yaml" --jobs 24 &
    P1=$!
    python3 tools/campaign.py "campaigns/ooo-w81-gate-$2.yaml" --jobs 24 &
    P2=$!
    wait $P1; r1=$?
    wait $P2; r2=$?
    say "LANE2 pair END: $1 rc=$r1, $2 rc=$r2 ($(date -Is))"
    [ $r1 -ne 0 ] && say "CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$r1: $1"
    [ $r2 -ne 0 ] && say "CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$r2: $2"
  }
  run_pair e083_crc32       e083_matmult-int
  run_pair e083_md5sum      e083_minver
  run_pair e083_nbody       e083_wikisort
  say "LANE2 all six done."
) &
LANE2=$!

wait $LANE1 $LANE2
say "both lanes exited: $(date -Is). Verifying results completeness..."

OK=1
rows82=$(wc -l < runs/ooo_w81_gate_e082/c0000/results.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$rows82" -lt 2000 ]; then
  say "INCOMPLETE: e082 rows=$rows82 < 2000"
  OK=0
fi
for prog in crc32 matmult-int md5sum minver nbody wikisort; do
  r=$(wc -l < "runs/ooo_w81_gate_e083_${prog}/c0000/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [ "$r" -lt 334 ]; then
    say "INCOMPLETE: e083_${prog} rows=$r < 334"
    OK=0
  fi
done

kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
if [ "$OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  say "Wave B formal DONE: $(date -Is) (96-way; e082 rows=$rows82; e083x6 verified)"
else
  say "Wave B4 lanes exited but results INCOMPLETE — orchestrator attention needed; NO DONE marker."
  exit 2
fi

#!/bin/bash
# Wave B 后接力落地脚本（编排者预研，cron 完成协议调用）
# 用法: bash /tmp/w8prep/land_patches.sh
# 前置: runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log 已有 "Wave B formal DONE"（无活跑批加载 campaign.py）
# 产出: 补丁落地+全套验证输出（提交由编排者/cron 逐单元执行，本脚本只落地不提交）
set -eu
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi

echo "=== 前置检查: Wave B DONE ==="
grep -q "Wave B formal DONE" runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log || { echo "FAIL: Wave B 未完成，禁止落地"; exit 1; }
pgrep -f "campaign[.]py campaigns/ooo-w81" >/dev/null && { echo "FAIL: 仍有门 campaign 进程"; exit 1; }

echo "=== 落地 1/2: campaign.py 公式补丁 ==="
cp tools/campaign.py /tmp/w8prep/campaign.py.pre_patch.bak
cp /tmp/w8prep/formula_patch_READY.py tools/campaign.py
python3 -m py_compile tools/campaign.py && echo "py_compile OK"
# 三组验证（与预研同口径）
python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml, copy, subprocess, sys, filecmp, os
os.makedirs("/tmp/landtest", exist_ok=True)
# 密度格 → n=2000
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
sc = next(s for s in d["subcampaigns"] if s.get("counting",{}).get("mode")=="event_coverage" and s["ooo"]["design_unit_id"]=="D18")
t1 = copy.deepcopy(sc); t1["campaign_id"] = "landtest_dense"
yaml.safe_dump(t1, open("/tmp/landtest/t1.yaml","w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
r = subprocess.run(["python3","tools/campaign.py","/tmp/landtest/t1.yaml","--dry"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert "2000 runs" in r.stdout, r.stdout[-500:]
print("TEST1 dense n=2000: PASS")
# 稀有事件 → 4000
t2 = copy.deepcopy(t1); t2["campaign_id"] = "landtest_rare"; t2["counting"]["density"] = 0.5
yaml.safe_dump(t2, open("/tmp/landtest/t2.yaml","w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
r = subprocess.run(["python3","tools/campaign.py","/tmp/landtest/t2.yaml","--dry"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert "4000 runs" in r.stdout, r.stdout[-500:]
print("TEST2 rare n=4000: PASS")
# 非计数回归（对 gatecheck yaml 用唯一 id，与打补丁前备份对比）
g = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w81-gatecheck-e074.yaml"))
g["campaign_id"] = "landtest_regr"
yaml.safe_dump(g, open("/tmp/landtest/t3.yaml","w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
subprocess.run(["python3","tools/campaign.py","/tmp/landtest/t3.yaml","--dry"], capture_output=True, text=True)
r = subprocess.run(["python3","/tmp/w8prep/campaign.py.pre_patch.bak","/tmp/landtest/t3.yaml","--dry"], capture_output=True, text=True, env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH":"tools"})
import glob, shutil
new = sorted(glob.glob("runs/landtest_regr/c0000/*.yaml"))
print(f"TEST3 non-counting manifests: {len(new)} 个生成（逐字节回归已由预研 diff -r 验证；此处验生成数）")
assert len(new) == 20
print("TEST3: PASS")
print("公式补丁三测全过")
EOF

echo "=== 落地 2/2: ooo_proxy iq sampling 修复 ==="
cp configs/se/ooo_proxy.py /tmp/w8prep/ooo_proxy.py.pre_patch.bak
cp /tmp/w8prep/ooo_proxy_patched.py configs/se/ooo_proxy.py
python3 -m py_compile configs/se/ooo_proxy.py && echo "py_compile OK"
build/ARM/gem5.opt --outdir=/tmp/landtest/e2e configs/se/ooo_proxy.py --cmd workloads/ooo/smoke/smoke --cpu O3 --chaos_iq --iq_mode wake_omit --iq_events_to_skip 5 --iq_count_only > /tmp/landtest/e2e.out 2>&1
grep -q "FINAL=45737cc9a76c0dce" /tmp/landtest/e2e.out && grep -q "CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT" /tmp/landtest/e2e/iq_injections.log && echo "E2E: PASS (golden + countOnly 语义)"

echo "=== 全部落地验证通过 — 待逐单元提交（编排者纪律）==="
rm -rf runs/landtest_regr /tmp/landtest

前置：公式补丁已落地（tools/campaign.py 含 "min(1, density)"）——否则拒绝执行
（计数格在旧公式下 n_runs=1，launch guard 正是为此而设）。
产出：campaigns/ooo-w8{2,3,4,5}-*.yaml 全部 stanza hang_timeout=300、
LAUNCH GUARD 注释块移除；打印每文件修改的 stanza 数。
提交由编排者/cron 执行（本脚本只改文件）。
"""
import re, sys, yaml

# 前置检查
src = open("tools/campaign.py").read()
if "min(1, density)" not in src:
    sys.exit("REFUSE: 公式补丁未落地（tools/campaign.py 无 min(1, density)）——"
             "launch guard 存在的理由未消除。先落地 land_patches.sh 步骤 1。")

GUARD_RE = re.compile(
    r"#\n# \*\*\* LAUNCH GUARD \(orchestrator, 2026-09-25\).*?"
    r"# stanzas' effective n land as one unit AFTER Wave B ends\.\n#\n",
    re.S)

FILES = ["campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml",
         "campaigns/ooo-w83-int-dispatch-rob.yaml",
         "campaigns/ooo-w84-int-decode.yaml",
         "campaigns/ooo-w85-fpsimd.yaml"]

total_stanzas = 0
for f in FILES:
    text = open(f).read()
    n_guard = len(GUARD_RE.findall(text))
    text = GUARD_RE.sub("", text)
    d = yaml.safe_load(text)
    n = 0
    for sc in d["subcampaigns"]:
        if sc.get("hang_timeout") == 600:
            sc["hang_timeout"] = 300
            n += 1
        elif sc.get("hang_timeout") != 300:
            sys.exit(f"ABORT: {f} stanza {sc['campaign_id']} hang_timeout="
                     f"{sc.get('hang_timeout')} 非 600/300，需人工核查")
    yaml.safe_dump(d, open(f, "w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
    # 落盘后再验证
    d2 = yaml.safe_load(open(f))
    assert all(sc.get("hang_timeout") == 300 for sc in d2["subcampaigns"])
    assert "LAUNCH GUARD" not in open(f).read()
    total_stanzas += n
    print(f"{f}: hang_timeout 600→300 x{n}，guard 移除 x{n_guard}，校验 OK")

print(f"READY: 4 文件共 {total_stanzas} stanza 就绪（300s 政策，裁决 12）")

#!/bin/bash
# W8.2 Int Rename production driver — the M3-gate throughput-validation
# batch (47 subcampaigns, D11-D24, ruling 12: hang_timeout 300s).
#
# PREREQUISITES — every one is checked loudly at start; any failure exits
# BEFORE touching gem5 (this script cannot launch early by accident):
#   P1. W8.1 Wave B driver has finished:
#       runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log ends with "Wave B formal DONE"
#       (campaign.py is live-loaded per campaign by that driver — the
#       formula patch and this batch must not race it).
#   P2. The event_coverage formula patch has landed:
#       tools/campaign.py contains "min(1, density)".
#   P3. The umbrella yaml is launch-ready:
#       campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml carries NO "LAUNCH GUARD" header
#       and every stanza's hang_timeout is 300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: 47 stanzas extracted at launch time from the umbrella yaml
# (single source of truth) to /tmp/w82_stanzas/sNN_<id>.yaml, then run
# SEQUENTIALLY, each with --jobs 8. PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper
# (man-* older than 20 min). A failed campaign records rc and moves on
# (honest per-campaign log; the batch summary reports it).
#
# Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-ooo-w8-experiments.md §W8.2
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

# ---- P1: Wave B finished?
if ! tail -3 runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Wave B formal DONE"; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P1 FAIL: W8.1 Wave B not DONE yet (driver_waveB.log)." >&2
  echo "[w82] This batch must wait — campaign.py is live-loaded by Wave B." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P2: formula patch landed?
if ! grep -q "min(1, density)" tools/campaign.py; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py" >&2
  echo "[w82] (expected 'n_runs = math.ceil(target / min(1, density))')." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P3: umbrella launch-ready?
if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"]
       if s.get("hang_timeout") != 300]
print(len(bad)); print(" ".join(bad[:5]), file=__import__("sys").stderr)
EOF
)
if [ "${bad_to%% *}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300: ${bad_to}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# /tmp sweeper (same policy as the W8.1 drivers).
(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w82_stanzas
python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    path = f"/tmp/w82_stanzas/s{i:02d}_{sc['campaign_id']}.yaml"
    yaml.safe_dump(sc, open(path, "w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
print(f"[w82] extracted {len(d['subcampaigns'])} stanzas to /tmp/w82_stanzas/")
EOF

echo "[w82] START $(date -Is) driver_pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER jobs=8 timeout=300s"
echo "[w82] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "used="$3" available="$7}')"
FAILED=0
for y in /tmp/w82_stanzas/s*.yaml; do
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) START $y ==="
  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 8
  rc=$?
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w82] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"

#!/bin/bash
# W8.2 Int Rename production driver — the M3-gate throughput-validation
# batch (47 subcampaigns, D11-D24, ruling 12: hang_timeout 300s).
#
# PREREQUISITES — every one is checked loudly at start; any failure exits

#       (campaign.py is live-loaded per campaign by that driver — the
#       formula patch and this batch must not race it).
#   P2. The event_coverage formula patch has landed:
#       tools/campaign.py contains "min(1, density)".

#       and every stanza's hang_timeout is 300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: 47 stanzas extracted at launch time from the umbrella yaml

# SEQUENTIALLY, each with --jobs 8. PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper
# (man-* older than 20 min). A failed campaign records rc and moves on
# (honest per-campaign log; the batch summary reports it).
#
# Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-ooo-w8-experiments.md §W8.2
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

#          96 jobs ≈ 13.5G + python stack — mirror of driver_waveB4)?

  echo "[w82] PREREQ P0 FAIL: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! tail -3 runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Wave B formal DONE"; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P1 FAIL: W8.1 Wave B not DONE yet (driver_waveB.log)." >&2
  echo "[w82] This batch must wait — campaign.py is live-loaded by Wave B." >&2
  exit 1

  echo "[w82] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py" >&2
  echo "[w82] (expected 'n_runs = math.ceil(target / min(1, density))')." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"]

print(len(bad)); print(" ".join(bad[:5]), file=__import__("sys").stderr)
EOF
)
if [ "${bad_to%% *}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300: ${bad_to}" >&2

fi

(

    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w82_stanzas
python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    path = f"/tmp/w82_stanzas/s{i:02d}_{sc['campaign_id']}.yaml"

print(f"[w82] extracted {len(d['subcampaigns'])} stanzas to /tmp/w82_stanzas/")
EOF

echo "[w82] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "used="$3" available="$7}')"
FAILED=0

  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 8
  rc=$?
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w82] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"

# SEQUENTIALLY, each with --jobs 96 (2026-09-26 parallelism upgrade:

toolUseResult.originalFile:
#!/bin/bash
# W8.2 Int Rename production driver — the M3-gate throughput-validation
# batch (47 subcampaigns, D11-D24, ruling 12: hang_timeout 300s).
#
# PREREQUISITES — every one is checked loudly at start; any failure exits
# BEFORE touching gem5 (this script cannot launch early by accident):
#   P1. W8.1 Wave B driver has finished:
#       runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log ends with "Wave B formal DONE"
#       (campaign.py is live-loaded per campaign by that driver — the
#       formula patch and this batch must not race it).
#   P2. The event_coverage formula patch has landed:
#       tools/campaign.py contains "min(1, density)".
#   P3. The umbrella yaml is launch-ready:
#       campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml carries NO "LAUNCH GUARD" header
#       and every stanza's hang_timeout is 300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: 47 stanzas extracted at launch time from the umbrella yaml
# (single source of truth) to /tmp/w82_stanzas/sNN_<id>.yaml, then run
# SEQUENTIALLY, each with --jobs 8. PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper
# (man-* older than 20 min). A failed campaign records rc and moves on
# (honest per-campaign log; the batch summary reports it).
#
# Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-ooo-w8-experiments.md §W8.2
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

# ---- P0: memory for 96-way (measured ~105MB/gem5 uniform at 48-way;
#          96 jobs ≈ 13.5G + python stack — mirror of driver_waveB4)?
avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -lt 14 ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P0 FAIL: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# ---- P1: Wave B finished?
if ! tail -3 runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Wave B formal DONE"; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P1 FAIL: W8.1 Wave B not DONE yet (driver_waveB.log)." >&2
  echo "[w82] This batch must wait — campaign.py is live-loaded by Wave B." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P2: formula patch landed?
if ! grep -q "min(1, density)" tools/campaign.py; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py" >&2
  echo "[w82] (expected 'n_runs = math.ceil(target / min(1, density))')." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P3: umbrella launch-ready?
if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"]
       if s.get("hang_timeout") != 300]
print(len(bad)); print(" ".join(bad[:5]), file=__import__("sys").stderr)
EOF
)
if [ "${bad_to%% *}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300: ${bad_to}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# /tmp sweeper (same policy as the W8.1 drivers).
(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w82_stanzas
python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    path = f"/tmp/w82_stanzas/s{i:02d}_{sc['campaign_id']}.yaml"
    yaml.safe_dump(sc, open(path, "w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
print(f"[w82] extracted {len(d['subcampaigns'])} stanzas to /tmp/w82_stanzas/")
EOF

echo "[w82] START $(date -Is) driver_pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER jobs=8 timeout=300s"
echo "[w82] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "used="$3" available="$7}')"
FAILED=0
for y in /tmp/w82_stanzas/s*.yaml; do
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) START $y ==="
  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 96
  rc=$?
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w82] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"

#!/bin/bash
# W8.2 Int Rename production driver — the M3-gate throughput-validation
# batch (47 subcampaigns, D11-D24, ruling 12: hang_timeout 300s).
#
# PREREQUISITES — every one is checked loudly at start; any failure exits
# BEFORE touching gem5 (this script cannot launch early by accident):
#   P1. W8.1 Wave B driver has finished:
#       runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log ends with "Wave B formal DONE"
#       (campaign.py is live-loaded per campaign by that driver — the
#       formula patch and this batch must not race it).
#   P2. The event_coverage formula patch has landed:
#       tools/campaign.py contains "min(1, density)".
#   P3. The umbrella yaml is launch-ready:
#       campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml carries NO "LAUNCH GUARD" header
#       and every stanza's hang_timeout is 300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: 47 stanzas extracted at launch time from the umbrella yaml
# (single source of truth) to /tmp/w82_stanzas/sNN_<id>.yaml, then run
# SEQUENTIALLY, each with --jobs 96 (2026-09-26 parallelism upgrade:
# measured ~105MB/gem5 → 96-way ≈ 13.5G, P0 memory guard below).
# PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper
# (man-* older than 20 min). A failed campaign records rc and moves on
# (honest per-campaign log; the batch summary reports it).
#
# Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-25-ooo-w8-experiments.md §W8.2
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

# ---- P0: memory for 96-way (measured ~105MB/gem5 uniform at 48-way;
#          96 jobs ≈ 13.5G + python stack — mirror of driver_waveB4)?
avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -lt 14 ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P0 FAIL: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# ---- P1: Wave B finished?
if ! tail -3 runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Wave B formal DONE"; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P1 FAIL: W8.1 Wave B not DONE yet (driver_waveB.log)." >&2
  echo "[w82] This batch must wait — campaign.py is live-loaded by Wave B." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P2: formula patch landed?
if ! grep -q "min(1, density)" tools/campaign.py; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py" >&2
  echo "[w82] (expected 'n_runs = math.ceil(target / min(1, density))')." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# ---- P3: umbrella launch-ready?
if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"]
       if s.get("hang_timeout") != 300]
print(len(bad)); print(" ".join(bad[:5]), file=__import__("sys").stderr)
EOF
)
if [ "${bad_to%% *}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w82] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300: ${bad_to}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# /tmp sweeper (same policy as the W8.1 drivers).
(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w82_stanzas
python3 - <<'EOF'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("campaigns/ooo-w82-int-rename.yaml"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    path = f"/tmp/w82_stanzas/s{i:02d}_{sc['campaign_id']}.yaml"
    yaml.safe_dump(sc, open(path, "w"), sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
print(f"[w82] extracted {len(d['subcampaigns'])} stanzas to /tmp/w82_stanzas/")
EOF

echo "[w82] START $(date -Is) driver_pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER jobs=8 timeout=300s"
echo "[w82] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "used="$3" available="$7}')"
FAILED=0
for y in /tmp/w82_stanzas/s*.yaml; do
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) START $y ==="
  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 96
  rc=$?
  echo "[w82] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w82] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"

content.thinking:
The w82 driver's DONE line is at 101: `echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"` — but it echoes to STDOUT (which the cron's nohup will redirect). For the w83 guard to grep it, the w82 driver's output must go to a known log file. The convention: launch with `nohup bash runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.sh > runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.log 2>&1 &`. The w83 P1 guard: grep "W8.2 DONE" runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.log. Let me standardize the w82 DONE line to "[w82] W8.2 DONE: ... failed=N" (greppable "W8.2 DONE").

Now write a generator that produces driver_w83/84/85.sh from a common template. Actually simplest and most explicit: write driver_w83.sh fully, then generate 84/85 via sed replacements (UMBRELLA path, batch tag, prev-batch marker, log path, stanza-count sanity).

Template structure (w83):
- P0: memory ≥14G
- P1: previous batch done: grep "W8.2 DONE" runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.log (w84: "W8.3 DONE" runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.log; w85: "W8.4 DONE")
- P2: formula landed (min(1, density) in campaign.py)
- P3: umbrella ready (no LAUNCH GUARD + all hang_timeout 300)
- Extract stanzas from the umbrella to /tmp/w83_stanzas/ at launch
- Sequential --jobs 96, per-campaign rc, sweeper
- Final: "W8.3 DONE: ... failed=N" to stdout (log via launch redirect)

Let me write a small generator script to /tmp/w8prep/gen_drivers.py and run it, producing all three drivers. Cleaner than 3 Write calls.

content.text: 写生成器产出 w83/w84/w85 三个 driver（统一模板：P0 内存/P1 前批完成/P2 公式/P3 伞形就绪 四重守卫 + 96 路 + 标准化 `W8.x DONE` 标记），并统一 w82 的 DONE 标记格式：

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# 1. w82 DONE 标记标准化（供 w83 守卫 grep）
p = "runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.sh"
s = open(p).read()
old = 'echo "[w82] DONE $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"'
new = 'echo "[w82] W8.2 DONE: $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"'
assert old in s; open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("w82 DONE 标记标准化")

# 2. 批次链生成器
TEMPLATE = '''#!/bin/bash
# W{N} production driver ({DESC}, {NSUB} subcampaigns) — batch {N} of the
# W8.2-W8.5 chain. Same structure as driver_w82.sh (96-way, four guards).
#
# PREREQUISITES (checked loudly; any failure exits before touching gem5):
#   P0: >= 14G available (96-way ≈ 13.5G, measured ~105MB/gem5).
#   P1: previous batch finished: "{PREV_DONE}" in {PREV_LOG}
#       (batches are sequential by design — batch = data commit between).
#   P2: event_coverage formula landed: "min(1, density)" in campaign.py.
#   P3: umbrella launch-ready: no LAUNCH GUARD + every stanza hang_timeout
#       300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: {NSUB} stanzas extracted at launch from the umbrella yaml to
# /tmp/w{n}_stanzas/ (single source of truth), run SEQUENTIALLY at
# --jobs 96. PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper. Per-campaign rc recorded;
# failures continue honestly. Stdout goes to this driver's log via the
# launch redirect: nohup bash {SELF} > {LOG} 2>&1 &
# Final marker (greppable by the NEXT batch's P1): "W{N} DONE: ...".
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${{avail:-0}}" -lt 14 ]; then
  echo "[w{n}] PREREQ P0 FAIL: only ${{avail}}G available (< 14G for 96-way)." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "{PREV_DONE}" {PREV_LOG} 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[w{n}] PREREQ P1 FAIL: previous batch not DONE (no '{PREV_DONE}' in {PREV_LOG})." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "min(1, density)" tools/campaign.py; then
  echo "[w{n}] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" {UMBRELLA}; then
  echo "[w{n}] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'PYINNER'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("{UMBRELLA}"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"] if s.get("hang_timeout") != 300]
print(len(bad))
PYINNER
)
if [ "${{bad_to%% *}}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w{n}] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300." >&2
  exit 1
fi

(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {{}} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w{n}_stanzas
python3 - <<'PYINNER'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("{UMBRELLA}"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    yaml.safe_dump(sc, open(f"/tmp/w{n}_stanzas/s{{i:02d}}_{{sc['campaign_id']}}.yaml", "w"),
                   sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
print(f"[w{n}] extracted {{len(d['subcampaigns'])}} stanzas")
PYINNER

echo "[w{n}] START $(date -Is) driver_pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER jobs=96 timeout=300s"
echo "[w{n}] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{{print "used="$3" available="$7}}')"
FAILED=0
for y in /tmp/w{n}_stanzas/s*.yaml; do
  echo "[w{n}] === $(date -Is) START $y ==="
  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 96
  rc=$?
  echo "[w{n}] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w{n}] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w{n}] W{N} DONE: $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"
'''

BATCHES = [
    dict(N=3, n=3, DESC="Int Dispatch/ROB D26-D55 (gate's 4 cells excluded — W8.1)",
         NSUB=103, UMBRELLA="campaigns/ooo-w83-int-dispatch-rob.yaml",
         PREV_DONE="W8.2 DONE", PREV_LOG="runs/ooo_w82/driver_w82.log",
         SELF="runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.sh", LOG="runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.log"),
    dict(N=4, n=4, DESC="Int Decode D01-D10",
         NSUB=68, UMBRELLA="campaigns/ooo-w84-int-decode.yaml",
         PREV_DONE="W8.3 DONE", PREV_LOG="runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.log",
         SELF="runs/ooo_w84/driver_w84.sh", LOG="runs/ooo_w84/driver_w84.log"),
    dict(N=5, n=5, DESC="FP/SIMD D56-D91 non-SVE (incl. D83-D85 three-gate part 2/3)",
         NSUB=115, UMBRELLA="campaigns/ooo-w85-fpsimd.yaml",
         PREV_DONE="W8.4 DONE", PREV_LOG="runs/ooo_w84/driver_w84.log",
         SELF="runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.sh", LOG="runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.log"),
]

for b in BATCHES:
    path = b["SELF"]
    src = TEMPLATE.format(**b)
    open(path, "w").write(src)
    print(f"{path}: written ({len(src)} bytes)")
PYEOF
chmod +x runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.sh runs/ooo_w84/driver_w84.sh runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.sh; for f in runs/ooo_w8{3,4,5}/driver_w8*.sh; do bash -n $f && echo "$f SYNTAX OK"; done; echo "=== 守卫阴性测试（应全 P1 FAIL）==="; bash runs/ooo_w83/driver_w83.sh 2>&1 | head -1; bash runs/ooo_w84/driver_w84.sh 2>&1 | head -1; bash runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.sh 2>&1 | head -1

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
TEMPLATE = '''#!/bin/bash
# W@N@ production driver (@DESC@, @NSUB@ subcampaigns) — batch @N@ of the
# W8.2-W8.5 chain. Same structure as driver_w82.sh (96-way, four guards).
#
# PREREQUISITES (checked loudly; any failure exits before touching gem5):
#   P0: >= 14G available (96-way ~= 13.5G, measured ~105MB/gem5).
#   P1: previous batch finished: "@PREV_DONE@" in @PREV_LOG@
#       (batches are sequential by design — batch = data commit between).
#   P2: event_coverage formula landed: "min(1, density)" in campaign.py.
#   P3: umbrella launch-ready: no LAUNCH GUARD + every stanza hang_timeout
#       300 (ruling 12).
#
# Structure: @NSUB@ stanzas extracted at launch from the umbrella yaml to
# /tmp/w@n@_stanzas/ (single source of truth), run SEQUENTIALLY at
# --jobs 96. PYTHONHASHSEED=0. /tmp sweeper. Per-campaign rc recorded;
# failures continue honestly. Launch:
#   nohup bash @SELF@ > @LOG@ 2>&1 &
# Final marker (greppable by the NEXT batch's P1): "W@N@ DONE: ...".
set -u
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi || exit 1
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0

avail=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
if [ "${avail:-0}" -lt 14 ]; then
  echo "[w@n@] PREREQ P0 FAIL: only ${avail}G available (< 14G for 96-way)." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "@PREV_DONE@" @PREV_LOG@ 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[w@n@] PREREQ P1 FAIL: previous batch not DONE (no '@PREV_DONE@' in @PREV_LOG@)." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -q "min(1, density)" tools/campaign.py; then
  echo "[w@n@] PREREQ P2 FAIL: event_coverage formula patch not in tools/campaign.py." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if grep -q "LAUNCH GUARD" @UMBRELLA@; then
  echo "[w@n@] PREREQ P3 FAIL: umbrella yaml still carries the LAUNCH GUARD." >&2
  exit 1
fi
bad_to=$(python3 - <<'PYINNER'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("@UMBRELLA@"))
bad = [s["campaign_id"] for s in d["subcampaigns"] if s.get("hang_timeout") != 300]
print(len(bad))
PYINNER
)
if [ "${bad_to%% *}" != "0" ]; then
  echo "[w@n@] PREREQ P3 FAIL: stanzas with hang_timeout != 300." >&2
  exit 1
fi

(
  while true; do
    find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'man-*' -mmin +20 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
    sleep 300
  done
) &
SWEEPER=$!

mkdir -p /tmp/w@n@_stanzas
python3 - <<'PYINNER'
import yaml
d = yaml.safe_load(open("@UMBRELLA@"))
for i, sc in enumerate(d["subcampaigns"]):
    yaml.safe_dump(sc, open(f"/tmp/w@n@_stanzas/s{i:02d}_{sc['campaign_id']}.yaml", "w"),
                   sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
print(f"[w@n@] extracted {len(d['subcampaigns'])} stanzas")
PYINNER

echo "[w@n@] START $(date -Is) driver_pid=$$ sweeper=$SWEEPER jobs=96 timeout=300s"
echo "[w@n@] free before start: $(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print "used="$3" available="$7}')"
FAILED=0
for y in /tmp/w@n@_stanzas/s*.yaml; do
  echo "[w@n@] === $(date -Is) START $y ==="
  python3 tools/campaign.py "$y" --jobs 96
  rc=$?
  echo "[w@n@] === $(date -Is) END   $y rc=$rc ==="
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
    FAILED=$((FAILED+1))
    echo "[w@n@] CAMPAIGN FAILED rc=$rc: $y — continuing (recorded honestly)"
  fi
done
kill $SWEEPER 2>/dev/null
echo "[w@n@] W@N@ DONE: $(date -Is) failed_campaigns=$FAILED"
'''

         SELF="runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.sh", LOG="runs/ooo_w85/driver_w85.log"),
]

for b in BATCHES:
    src = TEMPLATE
    for k, v in b.items():
        src = src.replace(f"@{k}@", str(v))
    open(b["SELF"], "w").write(src)
    print(f"{b['SELF']}: written")

- **Hang 类 L2 实证（W8.7 预实验）**：D28 停摆样本 ctrace=**0 字节**（故障冻结按序 commit 于首次 gzflush(4096) 边界前；600s 全耗在模拟停滞流水线）→ L2=presence 级；与极早 Crash 同为 W2.1 包络端点（F6 扩展）；W8.7 的 L2 信息量集中在 SDC 与迟发 Crash 样本。

**OoO 故障注入轨道（docs/gem5-fi/ooo/，分支 fi-ding）2026-09-25 状态**：

- **91/91 D 行全齐**：W4 Int Rename 14 + W5 Int Dispatch/ROB 31 + W6 Int Decode 10 + W7.1 FP Decode 6 + W7.2/3 VecRegClass 合并行 18 + W7.4 IQ/ROB 类参数化 12。W7.4（机制 f89f44b6 + 接线 6990ef2e）由编排者亲测复核后入库——实现代理死于 429 预算超限（192 工具调用），结局电池死后跑完 9/9，**亲测注入与电池逐字节一致是接管验证的关键手段**。
- **W7.4 修复 W5 D54 潜伏缺陷**：stale_read 原别名已回收 µop 的 _srcIdx（inst-pool 回收→悬垂指针→panic）；修复=合法域校验+regfile 永久表重建。
- **L2 边界发现**：极早 Crash 的 ctrace 为 0 字节（panic 早于首次周期 gzflush(4096 行)）——W2.1「损失<4096」包络边界端点，此类样本 L2 退化为 presence 级（五分类不适用）；W8.7 重放遍口径已文档化。
- **W8.1 M2 门**（E074/E075/E082/E083 = D25/D28×CoreMark/Embench×F0 n=2000）**双波设计**：Wave A gate-check（pilot-only formal_n:1）→ 门审（任一 pilot SDC>0 即杀全部）→ Wave B formal。**pilot 级门已过（2026-09-25，编排者独立统计）：SDC=0/280——D25 七格 140/140 全 Masked（gem5 PRF-commit 结构掩蔽=W5 D32/33 平台属性）+ D28 七格 140/140 全 Crash（跨 7 负载完全确定性=TC'23 依赖检查拦截机制复现）；Hang/Inactive/SimError 全 0**。Wave B formal 由编排者接管启动（代理 watcher 触发后未行动）：driver PID 755642 @16:45:41，~12h。**兜底 cron 模式有效**：代理 watcher 不可靠时编排者亲自门审+启动+协调注记（防双启动）。
- **口径裁决（W8 计划文档 §0 八条）**：Embench 格=六程序均摊 334×6=2004 套件级汇总；**D72/D73 合并行别名→D74/D75**（04 原文「不重复跑」+03 FP/SIMD→vec 核+N3 同池；字面 int 核读法=向静止 vec 池注入 design-void 且 D73 事件永不触发）；D61 混合={nbody,minver}；矩阵 226 行钉死 F0/F1/F2 无 F3。
- **campaign.py 工具现实**：一 campaign 一 binary → 226 格膨胀 333 子 campaign（w82 47+w83 103+w84 68+w85 115+门 14−重复）；备产 yaml campaigns/ooo-w8{1,2,3,4,5}-*.yaml。**driver 逐 campaign 重新加载 campaign.py——跑批期间冻结 campaign.py 改动**。
- **429 屠代理恢复模式**（两次实战）：工作树遗留=完整代码+电池死后跑完；编排者接管三步=盘点遗留→亲测复核（golden/注入抽查/py_compile/独立统计）→诚实注明交付背景后提交。

**Why:** 这些是 W8 量产与 W9 元分析的基础事实与已裁决口径，跨会话必需。

- **classify 超时判序真 bug（2026-09-25 修复 d6a72226）**：§2.2 carve-out（fault∧exit≠0∧无checksum→Crash）先于 Hang 判定且无视 timed_out——带故障超时击杀全被吞成 Crash。修复=加 `not timed_out`。**D28 全 600s 停摆**（destid→依赖永不唤醒→ROB 满→击杀）：「140/140 Crash」实为 Hang；门判据 SDC=0 不受影响。D28 型吞吐地板 0.8 run/min（vs D25 8.45/min）→ Wave B ETA ~94h。
- **事件覆盖 n 语义裁决（裁决 9，19cb040d）**：02 文档意图=n 个独立事件锚定注入（2000 run×1 射）；campaign.py `ceil(target/density)` 只在 density<1 成立，探针负载密度 ≥27.5 万→坍缩 n=1。正确通式 `ceil(target/min(1,density))`。counting 块必须保留（counting_basis=backfill 匹配键，冻结期无 yaml-only 改法）→ **公式补丁+46 stanza 生效 n=Wave B 后一单元**；yaml 已加 LAUNCH GUARD 禁止提前启动 W8.2+。
- **M2 门语义重构（用户指令 2026-09-25，裁决 13，覆盖 06 §5 与 04 D25/D28 旧文字）**：「须复现 TC'23 SDC≈0%、SDC>0=注入器 bug」框架作废——**目的是打破现有发现而非被其定义**。注入器正确性=正向控制（证据日志/复现/L2/golden，全已过）；TC'23=基线参照；偏离=平台发现（D25 100% Masked=gem5 O3 PC 字段 commit 不消费的结构掩蔽、D28 100% Hang=PRF 模型无依赖检查陷阱——均与 TC'23 Crash 主导不同）。**SDC 按传播轴**（用户口径）：掩蔽/隐蔽传播/传播后被保护机制捕获（panic/复位）都是传播，silent-vs-caught=检测覆盖率差异；五分类=测量层，W9.2 增报 propagated%（SDC+Crash+Hang 传播子集）。formal 期间 SDC>0=调查协议（核证据日志→复核分类器→无懈可击即结果），**非杀跑批**。
- **W8.2+ 量级（实测外推）**：221K-355K run；全快跑 18-29 天、25% 超时混合 ~99 天、全 600s 地板 308 天。**300s hang_timeout 政策已获批（裁决 12）**——Wave B 门跑批维持 600s 均匀口径至自然结束，W8.2+ 统一 300s。
- 顺带发现待修（Wave B 后）：runner.py:1079 传 `--iq_count_only` 但 ooo_proxy 只有 `--fpu_count_only`（argparse 崩，现路径未触发）。

**How to apply:** W8.2-W8.5 量产前必须先落地 campaign.py 公式补丁（LAUNCH GUARD 解除条件）；门通过判读引用 Wilson 上界口径；任何 D72/D73/D61 相关回填按别名/裁决处理；D28 型格的 Crash/Hang 语义按 classify 修复后口径。关联 [[ooo-w0w2-complete]] [[ooo-implementation-plan-06]] [[arm64-sdc-gates-progress]]。

Continue in-turn monitoring cycles — proven pattern, low value now (6 healthy cycles + linear progress + crons armed for failure cases... wait, actually the crons check completion, and if a lane died at 14:00, the 17:41 cron would catch it. In-turn monitoring would catch it at most ~10 min earlier. Marginal value.)

2. Do longer sleep cycles (e.g., chain multiple 9.3-min sleeps in one background task that runs for hours and only reports anomalies). A SMARTER monitor: a background watcher script that checks every 5 min and ONLY writes output if something is wrong (or every 30 min a heartbeat) — then it notifies me on completion/anomaly. This frees the turn from repetitive polling while maintaining supervision. That's the efficient design: a watchdog that exits early (notifying me) on ANY anomaly (gem5 count drops < 90, avail < 10G, FAILED/INCOMPLETE line appears, driver dies) or when "Wave B formal DONE" appears; otherwise heartbeats every 30 min. Max runtime ~6h. When it exits → I get notified → act.

That's much better than manual cycles. Let me write and launch it as a background task, then attempt to end the turn (the hook may block; but with the watchdog running, my position is defensible: active supervision delegated to a sentinel that will re-invoke me on ANY event).

The watchdog script:
```bash
# W8.1 Wave B watchdog: exit(1)+report on anomaly, exit(0) on DONE, heartbeat every 30 min
cd /home/sdc/gem5-fi
while true; do
  # DONE?
  if grep -q "Wave B formal DONE" runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log; then echo "WATCHDOG: DONE detected @ $(date +%H:%M)"; exit 0; fi
  # driver alive?
  if ! pgrep -f "driver_waveB4" >/dev/null; then echo "WATCHDOG ALERT: driver_waveB4 dead @ $(date +%H:%M)"; tail -5 runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log; exit 1; fi
  # failure lines?
  if grep -qE "FAILED|INCOMPLETE" runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log; then echo "WATCHDOG ALERT: failure lines @ $(date +%H:%M)"; grep -E "FAILED|INCOMPLETE" runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log | tail -3; exit 1; fi
  # gem5 count / memory
  n=$(pgrep -cf "gem5[.]opt"); a=$(free -g | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
  if [ "$n" -lt 90 ] && ! grep -q "Wave B formal DONE" runs/ooo_w81_gate/driver_waveB.log; then
    # e082/e083 campaign procs still alive? (a lane finishing legitimately drops count near the end — check campaign parents too)
    cp=$(pgrep -cf "campaign[.]py campaigns/ooo-w81")
    if [ "$cp" -eq 0 ]; then echo "WATCHDOG: all campaigns exited (gem5=$n) — completion gate should print soon @ $(date +%H:%M)"; fi
  fi
  if [ "${a:-0}" -lt 10 ]; then echo "WATCHDOG ALERT: available=${a}G < 10G @ $(date +%H:%M)"; exit 1; fi
  sleep 300
done
```
With heartbeat: print a line every 30 min (12 iterations). Hmm — for the background task to notify me it must EXIT. It exits on DONE or anomaly. Heartbeats just accumulate in the output file. Run it in background; when it exits (either way) I get the task-notification and act.

Also — one subtle point: the "gem5 < 90" check near the end (when lanes finish, count drops legitimately) — my design handles it via the campaign-parent check and only ALERTS via exit 1 for driver-dead/failure/memory. The gem5-count drop alone doesn't exit (to avoid false alarm at lane completion); it's informational.

Launch the watchdog, then report. The Stop hook... will probably still block. But with the sentinel running + everything else done, my next moves when blocked would be limited. Let me launch the watchdog first.

1. gem5 RSS GROWTH: earlier measurement showed uniform 105MB no-growth-tail... but that was a 20-min window. If gem5 processes leak (page tables, simulated memory structures growing over the 600s run lifetime — no, runs live ≤630s and get replaced by fresh processes). Hmm — unless some runs live LONGER (CoreMark full runs ~57s, stalls 600s — all bounded).
2. Page cache accumulation: m5out writes + trace files filling page cache — but page cache is RECLAIMABLE and `available` accounts for it.
3. ANOTHER process on the machine eating memory (another session/user process — the host may run other things!). The `free` available dropping while our stack is constant points to an EXTERNAL consumer.
4. The /tmp ctrace file from my earlier experiment (120MB ref + 0) — trivial.

At 96-way with 2 concurrent campaigns that's 2 parents + 96 workers = 98-99. OK that's consistent (the pool workers share the cmdline pattern).

If some gem5 processes have grown (e.g., the D28 stall runs simulating a full ROB with pending loads might allocate more — load queue entries pointing to memory, accumulating??) — 96 × 70MB growth = 6.7GB — matches!

Actually, the D28 stall: the stalled instruction blocks commit; the pipeline continues... wait no — if ROB is full, no new instructions enter, nothing grows. But the STALL happens gradually — the run spends up to 600s with ROB filling; before the ROB fills, the frontend keeps fetching. Hmm, memory growth could come from gem5's stats/histogram accumulation or the trace buffers... The ctrace isn't enabled for these runs.

Whatever the cause — the ACTION is what matters: available 9G with the stack consuming... let me measure precisely right now: per-process RSS of gem5 (max/avg), total python RSS, and what `free` shows in full (buffers/cache split). Then decide:

OR let it ride at 9G if the growth has plateaued (9G still > 0; the danger is hitting ~1-2G where the OOM killer fires).

Actually wait — timed_out=False + exit=-9 (SIGKILL) → the carve-out fires → "Crash (rename-inconsistency / fault-induced crash)". That's WRONG classification for an OOM kill. DANGER: if OOM killer fires even a few times, the e082/e083 results get polluted with fake "Crash" entries.

- An EXTERNAL build (ld 7.8GB + clangd 1GB + scons) from a PARALLEL SESSION (the lsu track at /home/sdc/gem5-fi-lsu) is consuming the memory and caused the pressure + swap

B. **Verify with the parallel session**: I can't message the other session. But the build (scons in gem5-fi-lsu) is legitimate work by another Claude session/user. The machine is shared.
C. **Protect data quality**: the key threat is OOM-killed gem5 misclassified as Crash. Mitigation: (i) reduce parallelism to keep headroom; (ii) OR add post-hoc detection: OOM kills are logged in dmesg (`oom-killer` / `Killed process`) — after the batch, scan dmesg for OOM events during the run window and cross-check any Crash-classified reps! # ---------------- write / dry-run ----------------
    writable = []
    for rep in cell_reports:
        if not rep["ok"]:
            continue
        e_id, agg = rep["e_id"], rep["agg"]
        row = rows[ridx[e_id]]
        already = any(row[i].strip() for i in h_res)
        if already and not args.force:
            note("SKIP %s: result cells already filled (use --force to "
                 "overwrite)" % e_id)
            continue
        writable.append((e_id, result_values(agg)))

    if not writable:
        note("0 cell(s) qualify for writing -- matrix %s"
             % ("NOT modified (dry-run)" if args.dry_run else "unchanged"))
        return 0

    note("=== %s: %d cell(s) %s the matrix ==="
         % ("DRY-RUN (would write)" if args.dry_run else "writing",
            len(writable), "into" if not args.dry_run else "into"))
    for e_id, vals in writable:
        note("  %s: %s" % (e_id, " | ".join(
            "%s=%s" % (n, v if v else "(empty)") for n, v in
            zip(RESULT_COL_NAMES, vals))))
    if args.dry_run:
        note("DRY-RUN: %s NOT modified" % args.matrix)
        return 0

    for e_id, vals in writable:
        row = rows[ridx[e_id]]
        for i, v in zip(h_res, vals):
            row[i] = v
    # utf-8 (no BOM) + CRLF: byte-identical outside the filled cells

Found the writer: `for i, v in zip(h_res, vals): row[i] = v` — writes vals directly; vals[5]/vals[6] (latency/fanout) come from `result_values(agg)` which returns empty strings when no L2/L3 data. The fix: in `result_values(agg)`, latency → "n/a" and fanout → "n/a" when absent. Let me find result_values and patch it. The cleanest fix location: the write loop `row[i] = v or "n/a"` — one-line change covering all columns (any empty result value becomes explicit n/a). But wait — should empty SDC% become n/a? No — result_values always computes the 5 percentage columns (0.00 with CI); only latency/fanout can be empty. A blanket `v or "n/a"` is safe and honest.

Let me apply the fix + re-run the backfill with --force (the 4 cells are already filled; --force overwrites) + verify the CSV now has n/a + audit G1 drops by 4.
